title: The Loss of the Titanic
question: What would have happened if only two of the 16 water-tight compartments had been flooded?

meanings.usage: 通常用来形容体积、规模、程度等异常巨大的事物，语义比large、big强烈
多用来形容容器、隔间等结构不会进水，也可引申指计划、论点等无懈可击的
指交通工具、容器等内部被分隔出的独立空间，也可指火车的包厢
指物体在液体表面漂浮不沉，也可指在空气中悬浮
用来形容事件、结局等令人悲痛、造成不幸的
指定期航行的大型客运轮船，也可指眼线笔等化妆品
侧重指长途的海上或太空旅行，区别于短途的trip
可以形容温度极低，也可形容表面覆盖着冰的
指负责观察警戒的人员，也可指瞭望台
指交通工具等的相撞，也可引申指观点、利益的冲突
常用来修饰miss、escape等词，表示差一点就发生不好的事
强调体积、数量、程度等大到难以测量
指物体或人的轻微抖动，也可作形容词表示颤抖的
可以形容声音、光线、气味等不清晰、强度低，也可指人快要昏厥的
指快速、猛地跳入某处，也可表示价格、数量骤降

phrases.usage: 表示船只、水手等启航前往某地，后接目的地

examples.en: The ship will sail for Sydney next week.
examples.zh: 这艘船将于下周启航前往悉尼。

phrases.usage: 表示“按照……的标准”，用来引出判断事物的参考依据

examples.en: By today's standards, this old phone is almost useless.
examples.zh: 按照如今的标准，这部旧手机几乎没什么用了。

phrases.usage: 被动结构，表示“被认为是，被看作”，用来表达人们对某事物的普遍看法

examples.en: He is regarded as one of the best writers of his generation.
examples.zh: 他被认为是他那一代人中最优秀的作家之一。

phrases.usage: 引导让步状语从句，意为“即使，纵然”，用来引出假设的让步条件

examples.en: Even if it rains tomorrow, we will still hold the sports meeting.
examples.zh: 即使明天下雨，我们还是会举办运动会。

phrases.usage: 此处意为“（船）沉没”，还可表示下降、下跌、被记下等含义

examples.en: The small boat went down in the storm last night.
examples.zh: 那艘小船在昨晚的暴风雨中沉没了。

phrases.usage: 意为“出发，启程”，侧重开始一段长途旅行，也可表示着手做某事

examples.en: They set out before dawn to climb the mountain.
examples.zh: 他们在黎明前就出发去爬山了。

phrases.usage: 表示“及时”，指在约定或所需的时间之前完成动作，区别于on time（准时）

examples.en: The doctor arrived in time to save the injured man.
examples.zh: 医生及时赶到，救下了受伤的男子。

phrases.usage: 插入语，意为“令某人惊恐的是”，用来表达某人得知某事时的恐惧情绪

examples.en: To his horror, he found his wallet missing at the airport.
examples.zh: 令他惊恐的是，他在机场发现自己的钱包不见了。

phrases.usage: 固定表达，意为“弃船”，指船只遇险时船上人员撤离船只的命令或行为

examples.en: When the fire spread out of control, the captain gave the order to abandon ship.
examples.zh: 当火势失去控制时，船长下达了弃船的命令。

sentences.en: The great ship, Titanic sailed for New York from Southampton on April 10th, 1912.
sentences.zh: 1912年4月10日，巨轮“泰坦尼克号”从南安普顿启程驶往纽约。

sentences.en: She was carrying 1,316 passengers and a crew of 891.
sentences.zh: 船上载有1316名乘客和891名船员。

sentences.en: Even by modern standards, the 46,000 ton Titanic was a colossal ship.
sentences.zh: 即使按现代标准来看，46000吨的泰坦尼克号也是一艘巨轮。

sentences.en: At that time, however, she was not only the largest ship that had ever been built, but was regarded as unsinkable, for she had sixteen water-tight compartments.
sentences.zh: 然而，在那个时代，她不仅是当时建造过的最大的船只，而且被认为是永不沉没的，因为她有十六个水密舱室。

sentences.en: Even if two of these were flooded, she would still be able to float.
sentences.zh: 即使其中两个舱室被水淹没，她仍然能够漂浮。

sentences.en: The tragic sinking of this great liner will always be remembered, for she went down on her first voyage with heavy loss of life.
sentences.zh: 这艘巨型邮轮的悲剧性沉没将永远被铭记，因为她在首次航行中就沉没了，造成了大量人员伤亡。

sentences.en: Four days after setting out, while the Titanic was sailing across the icy waters of the North Atlantic,
sentences.zh: 启程四天后，当泰坦尼克号航行在北大西洋冰冷的海域时，

sentences.en: a huge iceberg was suddenly spotted by a lookout.
sentences.zh: 一名瞭望员突然发现了一座巨大的冰山。

sentences.en: After the alarm had been given, the great ship turned sharply to avoid a direct collision.
sentences.zh: 警报发出后，这艘巨轮急剧转向，以避免直接碰撞。

sentences.en: The Titanic turned just in time, narrowly missing the immense wall of ice which rose over 100 feet out of the water beside her.
sentences.zh: 泰坦尼克号及时转向，险些错过了她旁边那堵高出水面100多英尺的巨大冰墙。

sentences.en: Suddenly, there was a slight trembling sound from below,
sentences.zh: 突然，从下方传来一阵轻微的颤抖声，

sentences.en: and the captain went down to see what had happened.
sentences.zh: 船长下去查看发生了什么。

sentences.en: The noise had been so faint that no one thought that the ship had been damaged.
sentences.zh: 声音如此微弱，以至于没有人认为船只受到了损坏。

sentences.en: Below, the captain realized to his horror that the Titanic was sinking rapidly,
sentences.zh: 在下方，船长惊恐地意识到泰坦尼克号正在迅速下沉，

sentences.en: for five of her sixteen watertight compartments had already been flooded!
sentences.zh: 因为她16个水密舱室中的5个已经进水了！

sentences.en: The order to abandon ship was given and hundreds of people plunged into the icy water.
sentences.zh: 弃船命令下达，数百人跳入冰冷的水中。

sentences.en: As there were not enough life-boats for everybody, 1,500 lives were lost.
sentences.zh: 由于救生艇不足，有1500人丧生。

exercises.prompt: “微弱的，模糊的” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: faint · /feɪnt/ · adjective · 微弱的，模糊的。可以形容声音、光线、气味等不清晰、强度低，也可指人快要昏厥的

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：巨大的，广大的
exercises.explain: immense · /ɪˈmens/ · adjective · 巨大的，广大的。强调体积、数量、程度等大到难以测量

exercises.hint: 即使明天下雨，我们还是会举办运动会。

exercises.prompt: 补全句子：_____ if two of these were flooded, she would still be able to float.
exercises.hint: 即使其中两个舱室被水淹没，她仍然能够漂浮。
exercises.explain: Even if two of these were flooded, she would still be able to float. — 即使其中两个舱室被水淹没，她仍然能够漂浮。

source.en: Even if two of these were flooded, she would still be able to float.

exercises.prompt: “表示在过去某个动作之前已经被完成的动作，强调被动关系和动作发生的“过去的过去”的时间属性” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: 主语 + had been + 过去分词 + 其他
options: Though / Although + 从句（让步状语从句）
过去完成时的被动语态
虚拟语气 (Subjunctive Mood) - 与过去事实相反
exercises.explain: 过去完成时的被动语态：主语 + had been + 过去分词 + 其他：常出现在有明显过去时间参照的语境中，用来描述更早发生的被动动作

source.title: 过去完成时的被动语态

exercises.explain: Four days after setting out, while the Titanic was sailing across the icy waters of the North Atlantic, — 启程四天后，当泰坦尼克号航行在北大西洋冰冷的海域时，

source.en: Four days after setting out, while the Titanic was sailing across the icy waters of the North Atlantic,

grammar.title: 虚拟语气在条件状语从句中的用法（与过去事实相反）
grammar.definition: 用来表示与过去已经发生的事实相反的假设，假设的情况不可能真实发生，表达遗憾、推测等语气
grammar.structure: If + 主语 + had + 过去分词, 主语 + would/could/should/might + have + 过去分词
grammar.usage: 从句描述过去并未发生的假设条件，主句描述该假设条件下会发生的与现实不同的结果

examples.en: What would have happened if only two of the 16 watertight compartments had been flooded?
examples.zh: 如果16个水密舱中只有两个进水，会发生什么情况呢？

examples.en: If you had studied harder last term, you would have passed the final exam.
examples.zh: 如果你上学期更努力学习，你就会通过期末考试了。

grammar.title: 过去完成时的被动语态
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某个动作之前已经被完成的动作，强调被动关系和动作发生的“过去的过去”的时间属性
grammar.structure: 主语 + had been + 过去分词 + 其他
grammar.usage: 常出现在有明显过去时间参照的语境中，用来描述更早发生的被动动作

examples.en: After the alarm had been given, the great ship turned sharply to avoid a direct collision.
examples.zh: 警报发出后，巨轮猛地转向以避免正面碰撞。

examples.en: All the tickets had been sold out when we arrived at the cinema.
examples.zh: 我们到达电影院时，所有的票已经被卖光了。

grammar.title: so...that...引导的结果状语从句
grammar.definition: 用来表示“如此……以至于……”，so后接形容词或副词，that引导从句说明主句动作带来的结果
grammar.structure: 主语 + 谓语 + so + 形容词/副词 + that + 结果状语从句
grammar.usage: 用来强调程度，说明前面描述的性质或状态达到了某种程度，进而产生了从句中的结果

examples.en: The noise had been so faint that no one thought that the ship had been damaged.
examples.zh: 声音太微弱了，以至于没人认为船已经受损。

examples.en: The book was so interesting that I stayed up all night reading it.
examples.zh: 这本书太有趣了，以至于我熬了一整夜读它。

patterns.pattern: At that time, however, ... was not only the ... that had ever been ..., but was regarded as ..., for ...

original.en: At that time, however, she was not only the largest ship that had ever been built, but was regarded as unsinkable, for she had sixteen watertight compartments.
original.zh: 然而，在当时，它不仅是有史以来建造的最大的轮船，还被认为是不会沉没的，因为它有16个水密舱。

examples.en: At that time, however, the building was not only the tallest skyscraper that had ever been designed in the city, but was regarded as a symbol of modern architecture, for it adopted many new environmental technologies.
examples.zh: 然而，在当时，这座建筑不仅是这座城市有史以来设计的最高的摩天大楼，还被看作是现代建筑的象征，因为它采用了许多新的环保技术。

patterns.pattern: The ... will always be remembered, for ...

original.en: The tragic sinking of this great liner will always be remembered, for she went down on her first voyage with heavy loss of life.
original.zh: 这艘巨轮的悲剧沉没将永远被铭记，因为它在首航时就沉没了，造成了惨重的生命损失。

examples.en: The success of this historic mission will always be remembered, for it marked the first time humans landed on the moon.
examples.zh: 这一历史性任务的成功将永远被铭记，因为它标志着人类首次登上月球。

patterns.pattern: As there were not enough ... for everybody, ...

original.en: As there were not enough life-boats for everybody, 1,500 lives were lost.
original.zh: 由于没有足够的救生艇容纳所有人，1500人丧生了。

examples.en: As there were not enough tickets for everybody, many fans had to watch the match on the screen outside the stadium.
examples.zh: 由于没有足够的票卖给所有人，很多粉丝只能在场馆外的屏幕上观看比赛。
